sentences.en: And was that, would you say that that film or any of the films around that started to solidify for you what you were confident in doing?
sentences.zh: 那是不是，你会说那部电影或者周围的那些电影，开始让你对自己的拿手好戏更有信心了？

sentences.en: And I guess the question is, at what point did you start to really kind of just dig into your style, quote unquote, or what your confidence was?
sentences.zh: 我想问的是，你在哪个阶段开始真正去摸索并确立自己的所谓风格，或者说你是在什么时候建立起这种自信的？

sentences.en: What I have is going to work.
sentences.zh: 我身上具备的东西是行得通的。

sentences.en: What I have is going to take me into something that I can make a living and also can be creatively fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 我拥有的特质能够带我走向能让我谋生并且在创作上得到满足的事业。

sentences.en: Like when did you get that feeling of I've got what I think it takes and I like that they're hiring me for this type of thing?
sentences.zh: 就是你什么时候开始有这种感觉的：我具备了他们所需要的条件，而且我很高兴他们找我来演这种角色？

sentences.zh: 仅仅是能够参演，能和哈维·凯特尔一起拍电影，并且和哈维有对手戏，你知道的，那简直就像做梦一样。

sentences.en: I never thought that that would be possible.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过这种事会成为现实。

sentences.en: And then getting to meet, you know, and work with actors like Tim Roth and Michael Mattson, who we sadly loSt.
sentences.zh: 然后还有机会见到，你知道的，并与蒂姆·罗斯以及迈克尔·马德森这样的演员合作，我们很遗憾地失去了他。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.

sentences.zh: 还有幸结识了埃迪·邦克，他曾是一名囚犯，你知道的，根据他的书以及《暴走列车》改编并写了电影《直闯虎穴》。

sentences.en: And so it was just exciting to be with these people and Chris Penn and the whole caSt.
sentences.zh: 所以能和这些人以及克里斯·潘还有整个剧组在一起，真的让人兴奋。

sentences.en: So just having done the movie was a huge confidence booSt.
sentences.zh: 所以光是拍了这部电影，就是对自信心的一次极大提升。

sentences.en: And then, you know, Quentin did us all a big favor by that credit sequence of having us, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，昆汀给我们所有人都帮了个大忙，通过那个演职员表序列，让我们，你知道的，

sentences.en: walk in the parking lot and our names were underneath our faces like as we were walking.
sentences.zh: 走在停车场里，我们的名字就在我们脸的下方，就像我们在走路时那样。

sentences.en: Because before that it was like, who's this guy who's, you know, like if my name was mentioned, you know, you couldn't put a face to the name.
sentences.zh: 因为在那之前，情况就像是，这家伙是谁啊，你知道的，如果有人提到我的名字，你知道的，你对不上脸。

sentences.en: Sure.
Now at least people could.
sentences.zh: 现在至少人们能对上了。

sentences.en: And I had something to show, you know, like if I was up for something and they wanted to see what I did, that was the film.
sentences.zh: 而且我有了拿得出手的作品，你知道的，比如如果我有幸竞争某个角色，而他们想看看我的表现，那就是那部电影。

sentences.en: Yeah.
And so that opened doors.
sentences.zh: 所以这打开了许多大门。

sentences.en: But, you know, as far as what my style is or anything, I never know, you know, I feel like I've done so many different kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，说到我的风格什么的，我从来都说不准，你知道的，我觉得我演过太多各种各样的角色了。

sentences.en: And depending on like who I meet, you know, like on the street, if I get recognized, I never know what they, you know, is it from a Coen Brothers, is it from Tarantino,
sentences.zh: 根据我遇到的人，你知道的，比如在街上，如果我被认出来，我永远不知道他们，你知道的，是因为科恩兄弟的电影，还是昆汀的电影，

sentences.en: or is it from Adam Sandler?
sentences.zh: 又或是亚当·桑德勒的电影？

sentences.zh: 所以有些人只在那种喜剧的层面上了解我，而其他人则通过别的作品认识我。

sentences.en: Well, that's a tribute to your career.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是对你职业生涯的一种肯定。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, you're able to do so many different things so well.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能把这么多完全不同的角色都演得那么出色。

sentences.en: It must be, you must have a great number of choices in front of you at times.
sentences.zh: 那一定，有时候你面前一定会有非常多的选择吧。

sentences.en: And how do you decide which way you're going to go?
sentences.zh: 那你又是如何决定自己接下来要走哪条路的呢？

sentences.en: So is it based on the people involved?
sentences.zh: 所以这是取决于参与其中的人吗？

sentences.en: Is it based on the kind of character, that being maybe different than the last one you just played?
sentences.zh: 这是否取决于角色的类型，可能和上一个你刚演的角色有所不同？

sentences.en: How are you making your decisions?
I guess it's different each time.
Sometimes it's just such a wonderful script.
sentences.zh: 有时只是剧本太精彩了。

sentences.en: And if it's an independent film and it's a young filmmaker that's starting to come up and, you know, and I love doing that type of work.
sentences.zh: 如果是一部独立电影，而且是个崭露头角的年轻电影人，你知道的，我挺喜欢做那种工作的。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
And then other times it is, you know, it's the people who are involved.
sentences.zh: 还有的时候，你知道的，是取决于参与的人。

sentences.en: But it really is the material.
sentences.zh: 但真正重要的还是剧本素材。

sentences.en: I mean, I try and, you know, go for the material firSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我尽量，你知道，首先看重剧本。

sentences.en: The script as a whole or your particular character?
sentences.zh: 是整个剧本还是你扮演的特定角色？

sentences.en: As a whole.
Yeah.
As a whole.
I mean, it used to be, there was a time when I would read a script and they'd say what character.
sentences.zh: 我是说，以前曾有一段时间，当我读剧本时，他们会说是哪个角色。

sentences.en: And I would just flip the pages to see when the character would be killed.
sentences.zh: 我就会直接翻页看看这个角色什么时候会被写死。

sentences.en: I swear.

Okay.

sentences.zh: 是那种角色会被杀死的剧本，还是那种角色能大放异彩的剧本？

sentences.en: Would you look at that and go like, oh, this is a good scene.
sentences.zh: 你会看着剧本然后说，噢，这场戏真不错。

sentences.en: This is, you know what I mean?
Oh, well, yeah.
If I, it was a, yeah.

sentences.zh: 我是说，有那种情况，比如如果是个很好的戏剧角色或者有一场好戏。

sentences.en: But, but yeah, mainly I would either get, I would either get beat up or I would be chasing somebody with a knife or, and then eventually get, get killed.
sentences.zh: 但是，但是，对，主要是我要么挨打，要么拿着刀去追某个人，然后最终被，被杀掉。

sentences.en: And, yeah, it went that way for a while.
sentences.zh: 而且，对，有那么一段时间确实是这样的。

sentences.en: You, and, and, and we touched on it and Jason, you just said too, you did so many different, not just so many different characters, but so many different kinds of, you know,
sentences.zh: 你，而且，我们刚才聊到了，杰森，你刚才也说了，你演过那么多不同的，不仅仅是不同的角色，还有那么多不同类型的，你知道的，

sentences.en: size of filMs.
You've done these huge Hollywood films and you've done these really small, in fact, you made the seminal independent film, Living in Oblivion with our mutual friend, Tom DiCillo.
sentences.zh: 你演过那些好莱坞大制作，也演过非常小的独立电影，事实上，你和我们的共同好友汤姆·迪西洛一起拍过那部具有开创意义的独立电影《开场alow》。

sentences.en: Yes.
Which is about making an independent film, which is one of my favorites.
sentences.zh: 那是关于拍独立电影的，也是我最喜欢的电影之一。

sentences.en: And, and then you just said that you like working with young up and coming directors.
sentences.zh: 然后你刚才说你喜欢和年轻的新锐导演合作。

sentences.en: Is it, is it that you like, you like the feeling of being part of that vibe of somebody who's just finding their way and exploring?
sentences.zh: 是因为，你喜欢那种感觉吗？融入那种刚找到方向、正在探索的人的氛围中？

sentences.en: Is that exciting to you?
Is that what it is?
Is it, it's, yeah, yeah, I really love that, you know, and I'm so like happy that I was, you know, part of Quentin's first film, you know, like he, you know, that was, I think,
sentences.zh: 是，是，我真的很喜欢，你知道的，我非常高兴能成为昆汀第一部电影的一部分，你知道，他，那对我们所有能看到像他这样的人来说，我想，

sentences.en: really exciting for all of us to see somebody like him.
And he had such confidence in what he was doing that that's what I think blew all of us away that he.
sentences.zh: 他对自己在做的事情有着如此强的自信，我觉得正是这一点让我们所有人都惊叹不已，他。

sentences.en: It was such a clear point of view.
So that, that kind of energy is, is contagious, you know, you just, it just makes you feel good about being in this business, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以这种能量是会传染的，你知道的，它会让你对从事这一行感到心情舒畅，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, and, and not knowing you very well, Steve, is, is like, I get a sense from you that you're, and you correct me if I'm wrong,
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，史蒂夫，虽然我对你不是很了解，但我对你的感觉是——如果我说错了请纠正我——

sentences.en: you're filled with gratitude and appreciation for working in where you are in life as an, as an actor.
sentences.zh: 你充满了感激和赞赏，庆幸自己作为一名演员在生活中处于现在的位子。

sentences.en: Like, I can't ever see you being a problem on any set ever, or having an issue.
sentences.zh: 就像我从来没见过你在任何片场成为问题人物，或者闹过什么矛盾。

sentences.en: Like, there's certain, you know, there's many, many types of actors, and a lot of them can't wait to share all of their ideas and their, and come to set with, you know,
sentences.zh: 有些，你知道的，有很多种演员，其中很多人迫不及待地想分享他们所有的想法，来到片场带着，你知道的，

sentences.en: there's those types.
And then there's other types that are just like, yes, I've studied my role, I have a few ideas, but you're in charge.
sentences.zh: 然后还有其他类型的演员，他们就是：好的，我已经研究过我的角色了，我有几个想法，但你是老大。

sentences.en: Like, where do you fall?
I think, yeah, I think I fall into, I mean, I, I've worked with so many direct, different directors, and I like to see what their style is, and how I can be accommodating.
sentences.zh: 我想，对，我想我属于，我是说，我合作过这么多不同的导演，我喜欢看他们的风格是什么样的，以及我该如何配合。

sentences.en: And since I've been directing, I'm even more so, because now I know what directors go through.
sentences.zh: 自从我自己也开始导演之后，我更是深有体会，因为现在我更清楚导演们要经历些什么了。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of the times they're just trying to make the day, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，很多时候他们只是想把这一天熬过去，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, we talk with Jason about it all the time, because I always ask Jason about the difference between being on either side.
sentences.zh: 对，我们经常和杰森讨论这个，因为我总是问杰森身处不同立场的区别是什么。

sentences.en: So, and you have that too now.
sentences.zh: 所以，你现在也有这种体会了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you know, it's like, well, why would I come through this door?
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，你知道的，这就好比，呃，我为什么要从这扇门进来？

sentences.en: Like, don't you think I should, it's like, okay, where do you want me to come through?
sentences.zh: 就像，你不觉得我应该——这就好比，好吧，你想让我从哪儿进来？

sentences.en: Okay, good.
Like, I can figure out my own motivation, like, if you want me to do this.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果你们想让我这么做，我自己能琢磨出动机。

sentences.en: And it's only when something really doesn't feel right.
sentences.zh: 而且只有当有些地方真的感觉不对劲时。

sentences.en: Like, if I can't find my way around, like, organically, why I'm doing something, or if the blocking feels off, yeah, then I'll say something.
sentences.zh: 比如说，如果我无法自然地找到我为什么要这么做的头绪，或者走位感觉不对，对，那我就会提出来。

sentences.en: But, but generally, yeah, I just like to show up and, and kind of do it, yeah.
sentences.zh: 不过，不过总的来说，对，我还是喜欢直接到场，然后，就这么演，对。

sentences.en: Right.
As a director, do you, as a director, have you had those moments where you've had to say, just come through the fucking door, man?
sentences.zh: 作为导演，你，作为导演，有没有过那种时刻，不得不说“老兄，你就给老子从这扇门进来行不行”？

sentences.en: Yeah.
Just, why, why the door?
sentences.zh: 就是，为什么，为什么非得是这扇门？

sentences.en: Because it's the only door that we have, and you need to come into the scene.
sentences.zh: 因为这是我们仅有的门，而且你需要进入这场戏。

sentences.en: Right.
So we need you in here to do the scene.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要你进来演这场戏。

sentences.en: Right, right, right, right.
Have you had those moments?
I really can't think of anybody who was, like, that way with me, and, you know, I've, I mean, I've had moments, but I, I, and, you know, being an actor,
sentences.zh: 我真想不出有谁对我有过这种态度，而且，你知道的，我，我的意思是，我也有过一些时刻，但我，但我，而且，你知道的，作为一名演员，

sentences.en: I always like to see what the actor will come up with.
sentences.zh: 我总是喜欢看演员能想出什么点子。

sentences.en: You know, if I have time to, like, rehearse something properly, which you don't always, I like to see what the actors do naturally, and then try and, you know, and then,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我有时间把事情排练好——虽然你并不总是有这个时间——我喜欢看演员们自然地发挥，然后试着，你知道的，然后，

sentences.en: and then block the scene.
Sometimes you don't have that luxury, you know, you just want to get in there and say, okay, the actors aren't here yet, let's see if we can get them to be, you know,
sentences.zh: 有时候你没有这种奢侈的条件，你知道的，你只想直接上手说，好吧，演员们还没来，让我们看看能不能让他们，你知道的，

sentences.en: this one here, this one here, and then we can shoot it.
sentences.zh: 这个站这儿，那个站这儿，然后我们就可以开拍了。

sentences.en: Right, so you're like, we're already set up for this, so this is how it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 对，所以你会觉得，我们已经为这个布置好了，所以事情就得这么办。

sentences.en: But JB, have you ever had that, where you've had to kind of, like, just go, fuck it, just do it, man?
sentences.zh: 但是JB，你有没有过那种经历，就是你不得不说，去他的，直接演吧，老兄？

sentences.en: I mean, a thousand times, because I, I, I, yeah, because I, I, personally, I'm such a fan of what the camera can do to help the audience understand what the scene is about,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一千次了，因为我，我，我，对，因为我，就我个人而言，我太喜欢摄像机如何帮助观众理解这场戏了，

sentences.en: so oftentimes I'll have a huge plan already worked out about what the coverage is going to be, and that's, that means that people have to be in certain spots,
sentences.zh: 所以很多时候，我会提前制订好关于镜头分切的宏大计划，这意味着演员们必须站在特定的位置，

sentences.en: and so I'll try to encourage the actors to make a friend of that blocking.
sentences.zh: 所以我尽量鼓励演员去适应那种走位。

sentences.en: But if they, if they don't, if they aren't comfortable with it, I can pivot for sure.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们，如果他们不，如果他们觉得不舒服，我当然可以灵活调整。

sentences.en: But Steve, with all the, the, the incredible set experience that you have, and, and the number of fantastic directors that you've worked with,
sentences.zh: 但是史蒂夫，凭借你所有的，那些，那些惊人的片场经验，以及你合作过的那些出色的导演，

sentences.en: it's interesting to me to hear you say that you are, that you gravitate towards new directors at times, because it seems like you would, you'd often be in a situation where,
sentences.zh: 听你说你有时会倾向于新导演，这让我觉得很有趣，因为看起来你似乎经常会遇到这样一种情况，那就是，

sentences.en: you know,
that director might be drowning in, in the, the, the, the, the unforeseen complications of any day, and, and you might get frustrated with, like, oh, my God, this is, you know,
sentences.zh: 那位导演可能正深陷于任何一天里都会层出不穷的未知麻烦中，而你可能会感到沮丧，比如，哦，天哪，这真是，你知道的，

sentences.en: it, it's frustrating for you to have been on so many sets that work so well, to then be sort of extending your patience and your experience to help out a young director.
sentences.zh: 经历了那么多运转良好的片场之后，要你不断展露耐心和经验去帮助一个年轻导演，这让你感到沮丧。

sentences.en: I find that just so generous of you, and, and is it taxing?
sentences.zh: 我觉得你真是太慷慨了，而且，这会很累人吗？

sentences.en: But I don't really find the frustration that, that I do sometimes feel with the person who is directing.
sentences.zh: 但我其实并不觉得导演本身有时会带给我那种挫败感。

sentences.en: I sometimes, I've, I've just been on so many sets over the years, I get frustrated with maybe, like, why did they bring me in this early?
sentences.zh: 有时候，我，这些年来我去过太多片场了，我可能会对一些事情感到沮丧，比如，他们为什么让我这么早来？

sentences.en: Or why, why, why are they shooting this first?
sentences.zh: 或者为什么，为什么，为什么他们要先拍这个？

sentences.en: It's the first AD you're yelling at.
sentences.zh: 你在吼的是第一副导演。

sentences.en: Why are they, you know, and so, and especially on, you know, Boardwalk Empire was the first time I had played a character, like, you know, repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 为什么他们，你知道的，尤其是，你知道的，《大西洋帝国》是我第一次饰演一个，你知道的，有连贯性的角色。

sentences.en: And for however many seasons that we did, five, and towards the end, I think I did start to, you know, be the guy that wouldn't, you know, like, they'd call me to set,
